# Gothamist

> > NYC and tri-state area news covering local politics, public safety, transportation, culture, and community stories from New York Public Radio.

Gothamist is the leading local news source for New York City, covering breaking news, politics, transit, weather, and cultural happenings across the five boroughs and surrounding areas including New Jersey. The site features in-depth reporting on city government under Mayor Zohran Mamdani, state politics with Governor Kathy Hochul, NYPD activities, immigration issues, and daily community stories.

## Key Topics

- Zohran Mamdani (NYC Mayor)
- Kathy Hochul (NY Governor)
- NYPD and public safety
- New York City government
- Immigration and ICE enforcement
- Tax-the-rich movement
- Albany politics and state budget
- NJ Transit and regional transportation
- Mental health crisis response
- Manhattan and five boroughs
- Donald Trump administration
- Winter weather and snow coverage
- Local community stories
- New Jersey regional news
